user.title: PaliwoMapa
user.description: Choose how to access PaliwoMapa. An account is optional.

account.title: PaliwoMapa account
account.description: Account access is used to retrieve profile information and favorite stations.

stations.title: Monitored stations
stations.description: Add stations by URL/ID or search within a radius of the Home Assistant home coordinates. Radius: 1–50 km. You can also skip selection and add stations later.

select_nearby.title: Nearby stations
select_nearby.description: Found {count} stations with PaliwoMapa prices in this radius. Select stations to monitor. Each option shows name, address, distance and available prices.

fuels.title: Fuel types of interest
fuels.description: Choose which fuel types should have price and station entities. You can change this later in integration options.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure PaliwoMapa
reconfigure.description: Update credentials or switch access mode.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check your email and password.
error.invalid_station_ids: Enter valid station IDs or URLs, or leave the field empty.
error.some_stations_unavailable: Could not fetch all supplied stations. Check their IDs/URLs.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check Home Assistant logs.
error.no_nearby_stations: No stations with PaliwoMapa prices were found in this radius. Increase the radius or try again.
error.nearby_search_failed: Could not search for nearby stations. Try again later.
error.home_location_missing: Set valid Home Assistant home coordinates in Settings → System → General, then try again.
error.select_at_least_one_fuel: Select at least one fuel type.
